title: CreatePromotionKitCallablePayload
description: Command promotion.create-kit (contracts/commands/catalog.json). A phone-verified manager of an event's organizer names the channels and promoters they will share it through; preview lists the tracked links apply would create, and apply creates one invite link per entry in one transaction, through the same invite link documents createEventInviteLink writes. Nothing is sent to anyone.

links.description: One tracked link per channel (an Instagram bio, a WhatsApp group, a flyer) or promoter. Labels must differ.

label.description: What the host calls this link.

source.description: The channel it is shared through, e.g. instagram or whatsapp.

kind.description: channel (default): a place the host shares the event. promoter: a person who shares it for the host.

attributionWindowDays.description: How long a guest who opened a link counts for it. Default 30.
